answer.text:
Levi Strauss & Co.’s fiscal 2024 SG&A expenses were **$3,246.2 million**, or **51.1% of net revenues**.

Calculation: $3,246.2 million ÷ $6,355.3 million net revenues × 100 = **51.1%** (rounded).

Source: Form 10-K, accession **0000094845-25-000005**, “Selling, general and administrative expenses” table, **Filing Summary, chunk 29**; net revenues also reported in **chunk 28**.
